hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook that routes swaps through Euler Protocol lending vaults. In `beforeSwap`, it handles all token accounting directly — depositing input tokens into and withdrawing output tokens from Euler vaults — and returns a full `BeforeSwapDelta` override, bypassing Uniswap's CLAMM entirely. Concentrated liquidity and direct donations are blocked at the hook level.
